draft.subject: Your open bulk import question — and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Your question about importing from a spreadsheet is still open with us, and I'm keeping an eye on it so you get a clear answer rather than a guess.

In the meantime, the piece that tends to unlock everything else is the first project — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm happy to set up that first project with you live and answer the import question in the same sitting.

Best,
Priya
